# npx-vibe 3.0.0

> Evidence-first, read-only npm package preflights for humans, agents, MCP clients, and CI.

Final planned release. Active maintenance ends October 2, 2026. No further compatibility updates or security patches are scheduled. Source and package remain available under MIT.

## Agent-safe CLI

    npx --yes npx-vibe@3.0.0 --agent <package-spec>
    npx --yes npx-vibe@3.0.0 project --agent --include-dev
    npx --yes npx-vibe@3.0.0 approve-scripts --agent

Commands and flags must precede a package spec. The outer npx installs the scanner itself. Scanning does not execute the target. Only the explicit run command executes packages; do not use it for automated preflight.

Default project scans require a lockfile packages map (npm lockfile v2/v3). Generate one with npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts. Explicit --direct-only selects a narrower review. Unsupported dependencies, package limits, or failures make the review incomplete and return exit 1.

New approve-scripts --write decisions are version-pinned. Review-needed entries are not written, incomplete reviews cannot write, and --agent rejects --write.

## Decision contract

Schema 3. Require schemaVersion=3, status=complete, coverage.complete=true, and decision.action=continue before proceeding with an already authorized workflow.

- continue: no blocking finding in the reviewed scope; not proof of safety
- review: pause for explicit human review
- stop: do not install or execute
- retry: incomplete; resolve coverage or errors first
- exit 0 Proceed; 2 Caution; 3 Block; 1 error/incomplete

coverage contains scope, complete, requested, scanned, skipped, failed, reasons. Counts cover subjects in the requested scope, not every source file. decision.safeToExecute has been removed. --json is the raw report; --agent is the versioned decision envelope.

## MCP

    npx --yes --package=npx-vibe@3.0.0 npx-vibe-mcp

Four tools: scan_package, scan_project, approve_scripts, list_providers.
Protocol 2025-11-25; structured tool results use schema 3.
Incomplete/error results set isError=true. Tools never execute targets or write permissions. API keys are never accepted as tool arguments.

## AI

AI is off by default. Online AI needs explicit opt-in, a provider, and an exact available model ID. --models lists provider configuration, not live models. Model profiles and bundled recommendations were removed in 2.0. Use provider-specific environment variables; never put credentials in tool arguments, generated commands, or output.

    npx --yes npx-vibe@3.0.0 --agent --ai online --provider <provider> --model <model-id> <package-spec>

Online AI sends bounded metadata and selected package source to the chosen provider. Source matching constrains AI findings; a model is not a trust authority.

## GitHub Action

    - uses: Devrajsinh-Jhala/NPM-Vibe-check@v3.0.0
      with:
        version: '3.0.0'
        command: project
        fail-on: caution

Errors and incomplete scans fail under every fail-on policy. AI/history are disabled. Marketplace: https://github.com/marketplace/actions/npx-vibe

## Limitations

Selected, bounded source review; false positives and missed behavior are possible. OSV is supplementary; unavailable lookups are labeled, not reported as a clean lookup. Single-package scans do not recursively inspect all dependencies. Execution is separate from verification and not sandboxed. External services may change after maintenance ends.
